title: 2016 AMC 12A Problem 20
statement: A binary operation \(\diamond\) has the properties that \(a\diamond(b\diamond c)=(a\diamond b)\cdot c\) and that \(a\diamond a=1\) for all nonzero real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c.\) (Here the dot \(\cdot\) represents the usual multiplication operation.) The solution to the equation \(2016\diamond(6\diamond x)=100\) can be written as \(\dfrac{p}{q},\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(p+q?\)

solutions.text:
Setting \(b=c=a\) gives \(a\diamond 1=a\diamond(a\diamond a)\) \(=(a\diamond a)\cdot a=a.\) Then setting \(c=b\) gives \(a=a\diamond 1\) \(=a\diamond(b\diamond b)=(a\diamond b)\cdot b,\) so \(a\diamond b=\dfrac{a}{b}.\)

Therefore \[ \begin{gathered} 2016\diamond(6\diamond x)\\ =2016\diamond\dfrac{6}{x}\\ =\dfrac{2016}{\frac{6}{x}}\\ =336x=100, \end{gathered} \] so \(x=\dfrac{100}{336}=\dfrac{25}{84}\) and \(p+q=25+84=109.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
